answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in gale, expire in beacon, and terrace lists each expiry. An copycat running 30 aliases hence needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3878 identities would post 1308 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
